plugins.description: Open-source platform for always-on AI agents: a software factory for Claude Code that takes your projects from tickets to merged pull requests, or an AI SRE that watches your systems. The plugin connects Claude Code to Tares over MCP, streams sessions in, specs projects with /tares:spec, and runs the tares-factory crew and challenger sessions.
